title: Program Manager
description:
RIGHTECH is a leading nationwide provider of technical staffing services, and we are currently seeking qualified candidates for a Project Manager starting ASAP.

Job Title: Program Manager
Location: Can be located anywhere in the US
Duration: Direct Hire
Start Date: ASAP
Job Description:

Our client is a premier turn-key provider of fiber optic and data center installation services. They are currently searching for an experienced Program Manager to join their team.

The ideal candidate will have a sharp business mind and proven ability to strategize and implement high-level program initiatives. As a natural leader, this person should have strong talent for project coordination and delegation. Ultimately, the Program Manager should be motivated by a desire to optimize productivity and nurture program success for key customer accounts/projects from inception to completion.

Objectives of this role

  • Strategize, implement, and maintain program initiatives that adhere to organizational objectives
  • Develop program assessment protocols for evaluation and improvement
  • Oversee multiple project teams, ensuring program goals are reached
  • Developing new customer programs such as installation criteria, material specifications, site requirements, etc. Oversee the management of long-term goals associated with programs and develop/measure success factors
  • Ensuring goals are met in areas including customer satisfaction, safety, quality, and training collaborating closely with all team members.
  • Implementing and managing complex changes and interventions to ensure project goals are achieved
  • Producing accurate and timely reporting of programs' status throughout its life cycle and consolidated status reports by customers across markets and service lines
  • Working on growth strategies with the sales, marketing and operations team to ensure consistency across markets.
  • Work closely with project sponsors, cross-functional teams, and assigned project managers to develop the scope, deliverables, required resources, work plan, budget, and timing for new initiatives
  • Manage program and project teams for optimal return on investment, and coordinate and delegate cross-project initiatives
  • Identify key requirements for cross-functional teams
  • In partnership with Area Directors, develop and manage plan to drive revenue for key customer accounts and be accountable for delivering against established business goals/objectives
  • In this role you will create and track best practices, organize departments workflows and monitor progress, deliver reports, and ensure compliance with all departments
  • You should have experience creating workflows (Visio), work breakdown structures, creating, editing and writing policies and procedures and be well-rounded with large telecommunications projects
  • Create and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) of individuals and teams to ensure projects are meeting expectations and develop reporting to show KPI's
  • Identify and drive process improvement initiatives
  • Work closely with project sponsor, cross-functional teams, and assigned project managers to develop the scope, deliverables, required resources, work plan, budget, and timing for new initiatives

Responsibilities

  • You will be responsible for the matrix management of project teams and Project Managers across multiple groups and ensuring the projects are completed according to mutually agreed upon timeline policies and procedures and project tracking Proven experience reading blueprints and schematics
  • Responsible for workload balancing among resources - across markets

Required skills and qualifications

  • Five or more years of experience in Project Management
  • Exceptional skills in leadership, time management, facilitation, and organization
  • Experience in managing stakeholders
  • Working knowledge of digital marketing
  • Outstanding knowledge of change management principles and performance evaluation processes
  • Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in business or related field.
  • Proven stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven experience managing a team.
  • PMP Preferred
  • Strong working knowledge of CRM software
  • Experience in proposal writing
  • Experience using computers for a variety of tasks.
  • Competency in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, and Outlook.

title: Outside Plant Inspector
description:
We are currently seeking qualified candidates for Outside Plant Inspector roles in the Ashburn coridor supportin VA Data. The project will start around 11/03.

Job Title: Outside Plant Inspector
Location: Northern Virginia (Manassas, Ashburn, Leesburg, Sterling) Loudoun County
Duration: 6 months contract to hire
Start Date: Monday, November 3rd
Job Description:
The OSP Inspector applies comprehensive knowledge of Outside Plant (OSP) construction, inspection, and safety standards to ensure the quality and integrity of fiber network infrastructure. This position serves as the field representative for quality assurance, permitting compliance, and project documentation. The OSP Inspector also assists with field supervision, mentoring of technicians, and coordination with engineering, permitting, and construction teams to meet project scope, schedule, and budget objectives.

Primary Responsibilities

Field Inspection & Quality Control

  • Review and evaluate fiber construction projects, including aerial, underground, and MDU installations.
  • Perform daily audits and inspections to verify compliance with company, client, and local standards (NESC, NEC, OSHA, DOT).
  • Inspect excavation, trenching, conduit placement, cable pulling, splicing, grounding, and site restoration.
  • Conduct pre-construction ride-outs to assess constructability, identify potential hazards, and verify route feasibility.
  • Document field conditions through clear photographic and video records of work performed.
  • Ensure proper installation of fiber-optic cables, splice cases, splitters, vaults, cabinets, and riser guards.
  • Verify footage, depth, and easement adherence; confirm as-built accuracy and quality.
  • Operate test equipment to verify optical levels, signal integrity, and installation performance.
  • Ensure adherence to Traffic Control Plans and MOT (Maintenance of Traffic) standards.

Coordination & Communication

  • Communicate effectively with contractors, project managers, and local agencies.
  • Provide daily progress updates, field notes, and QC reports using digital tracking tools or mobile applications.
  • Answer technical questions from contractors regarding design prints and specifications.
  • Coordinate with city, county, and DOT inspectors to ensure project acceptance.
  • Notify management immediately of damages, deviations, or safety incidents.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate as-built documentation throughout project execution.
  • Review design prints and report discrepancies or field modifications.
  • Support permitting, restoration verification, and client close-out package preparation.
  • Prepare work orders to correct non-compliant elements in the plant.
  • Ensure fiber design and splicing matrices are implemented correctly.
  • Verify system compliance with NCTA, FCC, and internal QA standards.

Team Support & Mentorship

  • Assist with training and oversight of OSP/ISP field technicians and drafters.
  • Support cross-functional collaboration between Engineering, Construction, and GIS teams.
  • Identify material and equipment needs and ensure proper usage during construction.

Safety

  • Promote a safety-first culture, ensuring compliance with OSHA, DOT, and company safety protocols.
  • Ensure PPE use and jobsite safety practices are followed.
  • Perform emergency locates and assist during outage response when required.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in telecommunications OSP construction, maintenance, or inspection (Fiber, CATV, or Telephone).
  • Knowledge of FOA, NEC, NESC, BISCI, and local construction codes and safety practices.
  • Experience reading and interpreting fiber design plans, system maps, and splice documentation.
  • Proficient in the use of field tools such as GPS, laser range finder, measuring stick, and handheld mobile inspection applications.
  • Familiarity with aerial and underground make-ready surveys and route validation.

Skills

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple field assignments.
  • Effective communicator with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
  • Capable of producing clear, accurate, and timely field reports and visual documentation.
  • Working knowledge of AutoCAD, GIS, or digital as-built platforms is a plus.

Education & Certifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; technical or associate degree preferred.
  • OSHA 10 or 30 certification preferred.
  • CPR/First Aid certification preferred.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to pass an MVR check.
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs. and work outdoors under variable conditions.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% and work weekends or second shifts as required.

Core Competencies

  • Field Quality Assurance
  • OSP Construction and Safety Standards
  • Problem Solving & Technical Accuracy
  • Communication and Collaboration
  • Digital Reporting and Documentation
  • Customer and Client Focus
Required PPE: Hard Hat, Safety Vest, Work Gloves, composite boots, safety glasses

title: General Superintendent
description:
RIGHTECH is a leading nationwide provider of technical staffing services, and we are currently seeking qualified candidates for a General Superintendent in Social Circle, GA starting ASAP.

Job Title: General Superintendent
Location: Social Circle, GA
Duration: Contract to hire (4 months, then permanent)
Start Date: ASAP
Job Summary:

The Structured Cabling Superintendent is the overall manager on a small to medium sized project. The Superintendent ensures that all contracted work is developed, implemented, installed and managed in accordance with the Company's requirements, including but not limited to: safety, quality, management and financial performance requirements. All aspects of the assigned project must be carried out as efficiently as possible with respect to staffing, materials management, financial management customer care and customer delivery goals.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
  1. The Superintendent will recruit, hire, train, manage, supervise, promote, discipline and discharge, if necessary, all project related staff. Effectively manage all human resource issues per Company policies and procedures. Complete recommendations for project related employees' performance ratings, promotions and pay changes. Provide guidance and mentoring to meet all customer and Company goals and objectives.
  2. The Superintendent acts as the senior Company liaison for operational interface with customer representative(s)
  3. The Superintendent will plan for, manage, monitor and maintain project profitability to achieve Company goals.
  4. The Superintendent will ensure that deadlines are met per customer requirements.
  5. The Superintendent will manage overall workload distribution, staffing levels and monitor the customer delivery and job installation progress.
  6. The Superintendent manages successful job completion; ensure productivity, job completion and compliance to project budget.
  7. The Superintendent will review all job cost postings for accuracy and completeness, including but not limited to, the preparation of invoices, customer collections and periodic financial reporting to the customer and management.
  8. The Superintendent will fully complete all Company and project paperwork accurately and on time (specifically timesheets, material transfers, work orders, change orders, tool transfers and others as required); ensure all Job Closing Packages meet customer and Company standards.
  9. The Superintendent will perform quality checks; manage the prevention of outages; conduct in day to day job walks to ensure quality; prepare red-lined as-built drawings.
  10. The Superintendent serves as main on-site customer contact for questions and/or concerns; attend facility and constructions meetings when required.
  11. The Superintendent will perform work consistently demonstrating a detailed level of technical knowledge; troubleshoot and resolve technical issues as they arise.
  12. The Superintendent will review and monitor operational processes for accuracy, completeness, and efficiency, including but not limited to estimating, purchasing, invoicing, warehousing, scheduling and reporting.
  13. The Superintendent will develop, redesign and implement process improvements as required to bring processes up to effective levels.
  14. The Superintendent will be in concert with the Training Department, monitor all quality and safety issues related to the operations department. Actively promote safety as our first priority.
  15. The Superintendent will lead any assigned operations meetings and training sessions.
  16. The Superintendent will also manage tools and truck inventory/maintenance.
  17. The Superintendent will complete any other responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications
Physical and Mental Requirements:

• The Superintendent must be self-motivated, positive in approach, and convey an appropriate professional image.
• The Superintendent must promote the Company culture and mission to all employees, vendors, clients and business partners.
• The Superintendent must possess proven problem solving skills, critical thinking skills and the ability to effectively read, write and give oral presentation(s).
• The Superintendent must also have excellent organizational skills and the ability to develop branch and job processes and best practices.
• The Superintendent must have proven high skill level to interpret blueprints and other project documents, including but not limited to, specifications, reporting and quality requirements.
• The Superintendent must be able to travel within the branch territory and/or regional territory as needed.
• The Superintendent must possess the ability to learn and teach the Company and customer project management systems.
• The Superintendent must be able to work at heights, off of a ladder and in confined spaces, lift up to 50 pounds and move up to 75 pounds.
• The Superintendent must be able to see and distinguish different colors, read small print and hear and recognize audible signals such as dial tones.

Education, Certification, License, and Skill Requirements:

• Prefer a minimum of three (3) years' experience of supervisory or managerial experience.
• The Superintendent must have a minimum of three (3) years' experience as a Lead Communications Technician or similar position.
• The Superintendent must also have a minimum of five (5) years' experience in telecommunications or a related technical or construction field.
